comment: Palace's Spack recipe on Linux: the macOS recipe's environment with the distribution's own GCC and no Homebrew. No target cap: a Linux processor's own features are what Spack detects, and SVE, where present, is usable.
layoutNote: A Spack build: every library's absolute path is written into the binaries that load it (measured on F0's Palace), so the home cannot be renamed after the build. It is built in place and published by writing its record last. The Spack clone, its configuration, caches, stage and install tree are all inside the home, so the user's own Spack is neither read nor changed.
